{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative or shows strong bearish signals.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent price spikes — apply a lag correction to avoid overshoot.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is significantly above recent 10-day average, reduce by 5-10%.",
    "When sentiment is neutral or positive, allow slight upward bias but cap at 10% above recent high.",
    "Reduce forecast volatility in low-sentiment periods — use smoother moving averages or exponential decay filters.",
    "If true outcome consistently underperforms forecast, apply a 3-5% downward bias to next period’s forecast.",
    "In high-sentiment environments, avoid overreacting to short-term volatility — use sentiment-weighted smoothing."
  ]
}
